name: Glossy gradient button
summary: A button with a vertical gradient, a white highlight on the top half and a soft shadow below, so that it looks like candy or glass.
how: Fill the button with a vertical 2-stop gradient, light blue to dark blue.
Add a white overlay at 35% to 50% opacity on the top half.
Add a 1px inner highlight at the top edge and a shadow of 0 2px 4px below.

origin.note: Apple showed the Aqua interface with glossy, drop-like buttons in January 2000.

adoptions.via: Web start-ups copy the gloss for buttons, badges and logos.
